## Motivation

Qwen4-Exp compressed QSA is currently rejected with `--enable-unified-memory`. Its persistent compressed index keys must stay with the corresponding full-attention KV pages when the unified allocator relocates them, and its attention/indexer paths must resolve virtual locations against the current page map.

This PR adds that integration for the QSA target pool and keeps non-final prefill chunks aligned to compression groups.

## Modifications

- Store full-attention K/V and compressed QSA index keys in one page envelope, with byte accounting and layer-specific views/translations.
- Resolve QSA eager and graph metadata, compressed-index writes, and sparse KV gathers through the unified page map. Disable the existing fused KV attention path for this layout.
- Initialize Qwen PLE side-state pools and register their slot-state lifecycle with the unified Mamba pool.
- Admit Qwen4-Exp through model overrides and align chunked-prefill continuations to the QSA compression ratio.
- Decline fused draft placement for QSA: the fused region carries K/V but does not carry independent QSA draft indexer state. Existing speculative budget guards remain in force; this PR does not claim new EAGLE/DFLASH support with unified memory.

Related: #39575 addresses unaligned QSA prefixes by handling cross-prefix groups on gfx950; this PR preserves alignment at scheduler chunk boundaries. #40143 expands speculative ring capacity and is separate from this integration.

## Accuracy Tests

CPU validation against this PR's source:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_unified_qsa_views.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_kv_cache_configurator_draft_gate.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_kv_index_translator_draft_disposition.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_prefill_adder.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_sparse_index_alignment.py \
  test/registered/unit/test_model_overrides.py
```

Result: **183 passed, 1 skipped, 224 subtests passed**. Coverage includes page-envelope movement, non-aliasing K/V/index regions, compressed addressing, physical write offsets, draft-placement rejection, chunk alignment, and model argument resolution. All applicable pre-commit hooks and `git diff --check` passed.

**Draft:** SM100 end-to-end model accuracy, CUDA graph replay, and allocator-compaction validation remain outstanding. GPU execution was unavailable on the validation host due to a driver/runtime mismatch. CPU tests do not establish GPU serving correctness.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not yet run. No throughput or latency claim; SM100 serving benchmarks remain required before marking this ready for review.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add focused unit tests.
- [ ] Update serving documentation after GPU validation establishes the supported configurations.
- [ ] Provide GPU accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.
